author: AstraSynthesis
purpose: Join every collected non-cyber first-party inventory record to an authored behavioral obligation, observable oracle, learning task family, report answer, and existing or new owner. This is a research ledger, not a second canonical registry or a complete current execution denominator.

scope.claim: Complete mapping of collected inventory records after explicit scope exclusions; not a claim that collection found every first-party surface.

limits: The 247 normalized language inventory identities can contain multiple original observations; all included observation locators are retained.
Registry membership, signatures, and named tests are static evidence only.
The canonical source registries must generate the production denominator; this file must not become another manually maintained membership authority.
No current Jet run, build success, tier parity, benchmark, or complete human beginner study was established.
Behavioral contracts here are family-level authored obligations. Exact per-member contracts and value-consuming evidence remain under the named canonical census owners.
Cyber-related members are excluded without evaluation.

families.name: Syntax, values, bindings, and control flow
families.contract: One ratified meaning for every accepted form; state changes, short circuit, failure, and observation order preserved.
families.oracle: Explain and predict a value-consuming example; reject a near-valid form; compare observation traces across applicable modes.

families.name: Types, generics, facts, state, and traits
families.contract: Facts hold under named premises, invalidate after relevant changes, and do not escape their scope.
families.oracle: Accept a valid proof premise; reject its deliberate violation; preserve the fact and result through lowering.

families.name: Ownership, memory, resource lifetime, and mutation
families.contract: Safe access respects lifetime, identity, ownership, mutation, and cleanup on every exit.
families.oracle: Observe mutation and release; attempt stale identity, double consumption, aliasing, and early failure.

families.name: Failure, optional values, diagnostics, and repair
families.contract: Every required failure is explicit, registered, source-bound, actionable, and consistent across tools.
families.oracle: Cause the real failure; inspect what/why/fix; apply the supported repair and observe the corrected behavior.

families.name: Collections, views, association, and streaming
families.contract: Values, mutation, copies, input consumption, laziness, and early exit follow one contract.
families.oracle: Consume results and remaining input; compare first observation, copies, failures, and early-exit traces.

families.name: Numbers, math, random, arrays, tensors, and computation
families.contract: Machine numeric, precision, shape, and reduction rules remain explicit; optimization cannot silently weaken them.
families.oracle: Check boundary and algebraic relations under stated domains, then measure the same workload and precision.

families.name: Text, parsing, serialization, formats, archive, and encoding
families.contract: Decoded values and failure boundaries match declared format, encoding, and schema; round trips use the stated equivalence.
families.oracle: Consume decoded values; reject malformed/boundary cases; compare independent format oracle and round-trip relation.

families.name: Time, clocks, duration, and scheduling
families.contract: Wall, monotonic, simulation, and civil-time meanings are distinct; quantization and scheduling policies are explicit.
families.oracle: Use exact controlled clock inputs; test conversions, transitions, remainder, cancellation, and overload policy.

families.name: Tasks, channels, concurrency, and cancellation
families.contract: Ownership, permitted order, cancellation, reentrancy, and close behavior hold on every path.
families.oracle: Compare traces under legal interleavings; exercise cancellation, early close, duplicate consumption, and exhaustion.

families.name: Files, paths, processes, terminal I/O, and environment
families.contract: Host operations preserve the documented availability, input/output, lifecycle, and error contract.
families.oracle: Run isolated success and failure workflows; consume file/process/stream outcomes and remaining resources.

families.name: Services, protocols, database, and deployment workflows
families.contract: Requests, state, transactions, cancellation, and resource bounds have observable domain contracts.
families.oracle: Complete a local real workflow with failure/recovery and controlled protocol/DB state; no cyber audit.

families.name: Games, graphics, media, UI, and host interaction
families.contract: Entity identity, time, lifecycle, input, output, and host availability are explicit; visual correctness has an owner oracle.
families.oracle: Launch actual surface, follow exact interaction runbook, compare domain trace and failure states.

families.name: Foreign binding, library export, source conversion, and mixed builds
families.contract: Source/target/layout/ownership/failure/encoding identity is checked; unsupported conversion never becomes successful translation.
families.oracle: Execute a declared same-workload boundary on the supported target; compare foreign oracle and explicit omissions.

families.name: LSP, editor adapters, semantic navigation, and live state
families.contract: Every tool projects compiler-owned facts for the correct document/revision; unavailable and stale states stay visible.
families.oracle: Edit during analysis; predict publication; exercise navigation, repair, UTF-16 spans, incomplete text, and stale results.

families.name: Learning, documentation, help, examples, and first-hour flow
families.contract: A newcomer can explain, predict, modify, and derive the ordinary task from the visible surface.
families.oracle: Pair correct examples with plausible wrong mental models; run the advertised task; report simulated and human evidence separately.

families.name: Debugger, REPL, notebook, replay, and resident development
families.contract: Observed state belongs to the current execution/revision; unsupported continuity and foreign frames are explicit.
families.oracle: Launch real interaction; change source/state; observe identity, supported reload, cancellation, and unavailable results.

families.name: Packages, discovery, build, targets, cache, and install
families.contract: Declared source, dependency, tool, target, and artifact identities agree; current readiness is not inferred from metadata.
families.oracle: Use a supported clean machine and invalid/stale inputs; compare offline/rebuild/target outcomes and receipts.

families.name: Conformance, test, proof, fuzz, mutation, performance, and CI
families.contract: The evidence has a real rejecting oracle, exact candidate identity, complete denominator, and honest result class.
families.oracle: Disable the obligation or plant a wrong relation; require detection through the production path rather than metadata.

families.name: Core root, CLI groups, and cross-cutting registry projections
families.contract: One canonical inventory projects names/help/routes/behavioral obligations without silent omissions.
families.oracle: Join every member and applicable route to a concrete consumed outcome or counted approved non-executable reason.
